data.description:
The **free-to-download version of Tennis Esports** offers everything you need to connect, play, and enjoy tennis in a vibrant virtual world. Play endless matches, customize your avatar, and socialize with players from around the globe!

Meet up with up to 10 friends in our **social clubs**, explore our **cooperative minigame area**, and enjoy **casual doubles**. You might even go head-to-head with a pro!

Want to stand out on the court? Visit the in-game shop for exclusive outfits and gear to enhance your style.

Explore and get a taste of the *Tennis Esports* universe with a selection of **AI matches, Courses, Arcade**, and the **TechZone** for **Forehand** and **Backhand** training. Take on limited multiplayer challenges.

#### **Social Club**  
- Casual courts for up to 4 players  
- Cooperative minigame area
- Limited match challenge invites 
- Accept unlimited match challenges from *Tennis Esports Premium* members  

#### **Tennis Esports**  
- Full avatar customization  
- Limited courses
- Limited AI challenges
- MirrorPlay Classic – play against yourself  
- HitEmAll Easy  
- Forehand 101 Basics and Backhand 101 Basics  

Unlock unlimited live matches, 10 AI opponents, 25+ training exercises, 6 arcade games, and more with **Tennis Esports Premium**!

Enhance your skills with real tennis techniques—explore our **TechZone Add-Ons** for advanced training, based on scientific research.

Download the app and join Discord 

https://discord.gg/8rcSArKJD4

Dear Friends of Tennis,

We're serving up some exciting updates to elevate your VR tennis experience! Introducing Version 2024.12.0 – packed with enhancements, bug fixes, and a dash of holiday cheer. 🎾✨

Improvements
Social Club: The bounce wall is now bigger and better – perfect for practicing your shots!
Event: Get ready to compete in the Holiday Cup – festive fun awaits!

Bug Fixes
Drone: The drone now behaves properly and won't stop firing anymore (affecting games like HitEmAll and exercises).
Social Club: Fixed an issue causing avatars to take flight after teleporting from high ground.
Social Club: Resolved timeline sound glitches when hitting the -5 sec block.
Social Club: Fixed teleportation and ball-hitting issues when instant match mode was turned off.

Plus, numerous smaller tweaks to improve overall gameplay and stability. 🎯

Thank you for being part of our growing tennis community. We can’t wait to see you in the Social Club for rallies, matches, and holiday vibes!

Your Tennis Esports Team

Dear Friends of Tennis,

Get ready for our biggest update yet, setting a new standard in virtual tennis with cutting-edge gameplay mechanics and breathtaking visuals! 
This major update brings a wealth of new content, improvements, and bug fixes. Here’s a summary of the most exciting changes:

### General
- Tennis Esports is now free to download, packed with a variety of new features.
- Unlock the full experience with the **Tennis Esports Premium Addon**, **Techzone BH**, and **Techzone FH**.
- Our loyal existing users will receive the Premium Addon automatically.

### New Features

1. Social Clubs (SC): A place to gather, chat, and have fun with up to 10 players.
   - Socialize in a relaxed environment
   - Challenge other players to matches
   - Enjoy mini-games like **BreakEmAll** and **The Tennis Wall**
   - Casual play on the SC court with up to 4 players
   - Join as a spectator if the SC is full or for a smoother experience on slower connections

2. Avatar Customizer
   - Create a personalized avatar in your profile
   - Customize with up to 100 outfit options
   - Choose from a wide selection of ready-to-use outfits
   - Select your preferred racket

3. Shop
   - Purchase all add-ons directly in the game
   - Buy coins to make your avatar truly unique

4. Quick Login
   - Access your accounts with one-click login if you have multiple TE accounts on your device
   - Easily recover a lost account by requesting a key from our support team

### Improvements
- Significant performance enhancements throughout the app for a smoother experience

Enjoy this exciting new update and elevate your virtual tennis experience!

Your Tennis Esports Team

Dear Friends of Tennis,

We’re excited to bring you a swift sprint of enhancements in your favorite VR tennis app! Version 2024.8.1 introduces two thrilling new features designed to elevate your game play experience.

#New Features
Locomotion: We've added a new continuous "Thumb Move" option, allowing you to control your position on the court with the thumb stick of your non-dominant hand. You can choose the UP direction of the thumb stick (towards the net, hand direction, or head direction).
Thumb Move: With the new "Auto Move" feature, the player automatically moves to the hit point but can override this by using the thumb stick. If deactivated, the player remains stationary unless the thumb stick is used (Advanced mode).
ELO: Your player profile now displays your current ELO , the top 10 players on Tennis Esports, and your rank in the global ELO leader board.

#Improvements
Settings: added settings to the game mode pause menu.

#Addon
New Coaching Rule: Introducing the "Racket Miss Rule" to sharpen your game play.

#Bug Fixes
AI Challenges/Trainings: All users can now access these game modes again.

Keep swinging, and enjoy the upgraded experience!

Serving up a big THANK YOU to our community!

Your Tennis Esports Team
